can_do_goal: I can point to and say snack words.
kp_focus: VOC: snack words; LST: listen and point; SP: repeat single words
vocabulary_focus: apple | banana | orange | sandwich | cookie | cake | bread
repair_focus: If you are not sure, look at the tray again and say one word only.

can_do_goal: I can say what snack I want.
kp_focus: CHK: I want ...; VOC: snack choice; SI: answer a simple choice question
vocabulary_focus: I want | apple | banana | orange | sandwich | cookie
repair_focus: Start with the chunk I want. Then add one snack word.

can_do_goal: I can ask for a snack politely.
kp_focus: CHK: I want ..., please.; REG: friendly polite asking; SI: helper/learner exchange
repair_focus: If please is missing, say the whole line again with please at the end.

can_do_goal: I can notice and use fixed snack chunks: a banana, an apple.
kp_focus: GRM: a/an noticing as fixed chunks only; VOC: snack chunks; STR: repair by model copying
vocabulary_focus: a banana | a sandwich | a cookie | an apple | an orange
repair_focus: Use the repair picture. Copy the full chunk, not only the food word.

can_do_goal: I can name simple drinks and choose one drink.
kp_focus: VOC: drink words; CHK: I want water/milk/juice, please.; SI: simple choice
repair_focus: For drinks, use the drink word after I want: I want juice, please.

can_do_goal: I can ask for one snack and one drink in a short role-play.
kp_focus: SI: snack order role-play; CHK: I want ..., please.; VOC: snack + drink; REG: thank you
vocabulary_focus: hello | I want | please | here you are | thank you | snack | drink
repair_focus: If the line is too long, say it in two parts: I want a sandwich. I want juice, please.

can_do_goal: I can make and rehearse my snack order card.
kp_focus: PRJ: project rehearsal; SP: short snack order; WRT: copy one snack word and one drink word; STR: self-check
vocabulary_focus: snack card | apple | banana | sandwich | water | milk | juice | please
repair_focus: Check three parts: snack word, drink word, please.
